column3: MT 20:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “securely.”
“Your offerings” is rendered “your meal offerings,” and “may He accept (as fat)” as “find … acceptable.”
Close to the Hebrew; “according to your heart” is rendered “your heart's desire,” and “plan” as “counsel.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we will raise a banner” is rendered “we will set up our banners.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mighty deeds of the salvation of” is rendered “the saving strength of.”
The first line has no verb in Hebrew, and the last verb means “we will call to remembrance”; NASB supplies and uses “boast.”
The Hebrew accents read “O LORD, save the king; may He answer us”; NASB renders “Save, O LORD; May the King answer us.”
